title: Cocktail 2 Is the Most Wanted Film in India Right Now. The Trailer Numbers Are Obscene.
excerpt: Shahid Kapoor, Kriti Sanon and Rashmika Mandanna's love triangle has claimed #1 on IMDb and topped YouTube trailer charts across eight countries — eleven days before the film even releases.
body:
Eleven days out from release, and **Cocktail 2** is already behaving like a hit.

<youtube>https://youtube.com/watch?v=XXxUqLHq1xg</youtube>

The romantic entertainer starring **Shahid Kapoor**, **Kriti Sanon**, and **Rashmika Mandanna** has claimed the top spot on IMDb's real-time most-anticipated Indian movies list for 2026 — commanding a staggering 21% page-view share on the platform, nearly triple the next closest Indian title. For context, **Akshay Kumar**'s ensemble comedy *Welcome to the Jungle*, releasing a week later, sits at sixth place with just over 7%.

https://x.com/shahidkapoor/status/2062075322527555977

But IMDb is only half the story. The trailer, which dropped on June 2, has already hit #1 on YouTube's Movie Trailer Charts in eight countries — India, the UK, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Qatar, Bahrain, and Kuwait — and cracked the U.S. top 10 within days of launch, sitting comfortably alongside major Hollywood studio releases. For a Hindi-language romance, that is not normal. That is a signal.

## The Chemistry You're Here For

Director **Homi Adajania** — who helmed the 2012 original with its career-defining turns from Deepika Padukone, Saif Ali Khan, and Diana Penty — has assembled a trio that feels tailor-made for the sequel's promise of messy, modern love. Shahid Kapoor reunites with Kriti Sanon after the buzzy success of *Teri Baaton Mein Aisa Uljha Jiya*, while Rashmika Mandanna joins as the wildcard third vertex in what's being positioned as a love triangle with actual teeth.

The trailer gives you glamour in waves — sun-drenched European locations, a wardrobe that leans designer-casual-expensive, and a trio that looks like they genuinely enjoy being in the same frame. Social media hasn't stopped dissecting the chemistry since the trailer dropped, with clips of all three leads trending independently across platforms.

## The Music Is Already Doing Numbers

If the visuals pull you in, the music is what's going to keep you. At an exclusive media preview event in Mumbai attended by the cast, Adajania, producers **Dinesh Vijan** (Maddock Films) and **Luv Ranjan**, and composer **Pritam Chakraborty**, two unreleased tracks were showcased — and the early reports are electric.

*Mashooka* is described as a high-energy romantic number filmed across picturesque locations in Sicily, Italy, featuring Shahid and Kriti at their most magnetic. It's the kind of song clearly designed to own dance floors at desi weddings from Edison to Southall by the end of summer.

Then there's *Tujhko* — a soulful, emotionally devastating ballad sung by **Arijit Singh**, centred on the dynamic between Shahid and Rashmika. Attendees at the preview reportedly went quiet during the playback. The kind of quiet that means the song landed exactly where it was supposed to.

## Why the Diaspora Should Be Paying Attention

The original *Cocktail* wasn't just a box office success in India — it became a cultural touchstone for a generation of diaspora viewers. That easy, lived-in portrayal of modern relationships, the London setting, Deepika's iconic transformation from party girl to heartbreak — it all hit different when you were watching it on a laptop in your college dorm in New Jersey or a flat in Hounslow.

Fourteen years later, the sequel is leaning into that exact audience. The trailer's dominant performance across the UK, Gulf, and North American markets isn't accidental. Maddock Films and Luv Films — two banners with a near-flawless commercial track record — are positioning this as a global Hindi release, and the early signs suggest the diaspora is already bought in. The anticipation among NRIs is palpable, as many are eager to reconnect with the themes of love and friendship that resonate deeply within their own lives, often bridging the gap between their Indian roots and their current realities abroad.

Written by Luv Ranjan and Tarun Jain, *Cocktail 2* is described as a spiritual successor rather than a direct sequel — same emotional DNA, entirely new characters, contemporary urban setting. Think of it less as a franchise play and more as a mood being revisited with sharper tools and bigger stars.

## The Month It Has to Survive

Here's the thing, though: *Cocktail 2* isn't dropping into a vacuum. June 2026 is shaping up to be the most loaded month in Bollywood history — nine major releases in four weeks, with over ₹1,400 crore at stake across the industry. The film arrives on June 19, sandwiched between *Main Vaapas Aaunga* (June 12) and *Welcome to the Jungle* (June 26). Screen allocation alone will be a war.

But if the IMDb numbers, the YouTube charts, and the music preview are any indication, *Cocktail 2* isn't worried about competition. It's the one everyone is already watching.

*Cocktail 2 releases in theatres on June 19, 2026.*
